notes:
- The palette editor no longer closes the title: Back inside the title page's appearance editor used to dismiss the whole page; it now closes only the editor and keeps the live preview. The editor clears the status and gesture bars, and the tier board's search button now searches instead of opening the zoom slider.
- Your manga shelf finally has a count: Home read only the anime statistics block, so Manga said 0 items beside a full shelf. The viewer query asks for the manga count too.
- Cast cards share one 128dp size, with a round actor portrait and a favourites pill, and the profile banner runs edge to edge at 320dp with only its bottom corners rounded.
- The greeting highlights the username, has twice as many lines and types its second line on with a caret.
- The tier board has its own search: a full-height sheet of nine-poster pages swiped sideways, with a plus on each poster that opens the tier chooser. The tier bar is a 52dp capsule with its own grouped actions.
- Settings leads with the AniList account and connection check, Library gets its own icon and Device Manager shows a phone.
